method: Compared factorial-design guidance with OpenAI Evaluation best practices and the NIST Engineering Statistics Handbook; reran seven offline assertions against both lesson Python fences after correcting exact ID and priority-column grading. No provider call or historical replay was made.

observations.trace: The scorer checks input-field scope, exact TC-01…TC-15 first-field IDs, exact priority values in the fourth field, and host-normalized completion status. Factorial contrasts use identical remaining-factor contexts and reject missing cells or unequal completion counts; the historical summary remains non-causal.

limitations: The archived historical stdout does not contain raw requests, responses, model snapshot, scorer version or per-run usage; its values cannot be independently recomputed.
Offline fixtures verify example code and hand-computed contrasts only; they do not establish statistical significance, production error probability, model quality, or an online A/B result.
No provider or production experiment was run.
The offline scorer uses synthetic fixtures and does not calibrate semantic correctness or estimate the true failure distribution.
